rs1427407.verdict: Supported partial mechanism: GATA1 and TAL1 occupancy claims survive, while the enhancer-activity and enhancer-to-BCL11A required links remain unresolved. This is a new view of the earlier saved run, not a live rerun of the new recovery code.
rs1427407.factor_recovery: GATA1 and TAL1 supported; full chain unresolved
notes: C8 and C9 use E346, an allele-comparing ChIP–pyrosequencing experiment in primary erythroblasts. The G allele has greater measured occupancy. Two factor claims from this record do not represent two independent studies.

These claims are optional within H1. The previous top-level outcome obscured them because required C1 and C2 remained unassessed; the new report displays both axes without changing that stored outcome.
The experiment supports occupancy in its measured context. It does not alone establish two separate direct DNA contacts, a GATA1–TAL1 complex, enhancer activity or disease mediation.
The historical run had already recovered this evidence. It demonstrates the reporting improvement, not new evidence that the current extraction recovery generalises.

rs12740374.verdict: Recovery not achieved before a currency guard stopped further investigation. No supported variant-level molecular claim was recovered; this is an incomplete investigation, not a biological rejection.
rs12740374.factor_recovery: C/EBP group proposed; no supported TF member
notes: Only chr1:109274968 G>T and germline origin were supplied. SORT1, PSRC1, CELSR2 and GSTM2 were candidate targets; a C/EBP group with CEBPA, CEBPB and CEBPE was proposed. All of this remains hypothesis or association-level content.
The expected primary study, Musunuru et al. (2010; PMID 20686566), was not read. The two selected reads were abstract-only; no literature experiment entered the evidence graph.
Of 1,013 evidence records, 698 came from GWAS Catalog. The L2G call returned a 75-set trait survey requiring a named trait, not target-gene support. More records did not close the mechanistic gap.
The run used 8 model calls, 10 tools and $0.076231. A subsequent planning request required a $0.1120 worst-case reservation, exceeding the remaining shared balance. No final model comparison ran.

The external audit expectation is a T-allele C/EBP mechanism with experimentally supported CEBPA involvement and SORT1 regulation in specified hepatic assays. It is not proof that CEBPB or CEBPE are excluded, and was never supplied to the agents.

tert_c228t.verdict: Primary reporter evidence was discovered but not accepted or adopted. The investigation ended with no supported molecular claim and unresolved promoter/activity and expression candidates.
tert_c228t.factor_recovery: No supported GABPA claim; reporter remained a lead
notes: Only chr5:1295113 G>A and somatic origin were supplied. Variant annotation independently returned rs1242535815. The supplied variant was not labelled C228T in the agent request.

The literature route followed a review to Huang et al. (2013; PMID 23348506, PMC4423787). The paper reports increased mutant promoter reporter activity; its result paragraph uses C228T/C250T shorthand, with coordinates defined elsewhere in the article.

D38 and D43 refused extraction because the coordinate supplied in about_variants was absent from the selected result paragraph and the article mentioned multiple variants. The follow-up did not produce a source-backed local-name mapping or verify the GRCh37/GRCh38 and strand crosswalk to the case.

Even with identity resolved, reporter activity is not the same endpoint as endogenous EH38E3622530 activity. A refined reporter-scoped claim could preserve the finding while leaving the endogenous claim unresolved. No such refinement was accepted in this run.
The expected GABP study (Bell et al., 2015; PMID 25977370) was not read. QBiC ETS predictions and GABPA mentions are not evidence-linked GABPA recovery.
CIViC returned a GraphQL schema error; GTEx had no genotype for this variant. Neither outcome is biological negative evidence.
17 model calls, 15 tools and 8 literature reads cost $0.031657. The investigation stopped at the model-call reservation guard, then completed audit and comparison. No live rerun was performed.
